notes: Smaller and simpler: .7z mods are no longer unpacked by the app (unpack them with 7-Zip first, then add the .pak - or zip the unpacked files and add the .zip). If you used the old offline sandbox, press Restore the game once.

sandbox_off.message: The offline sandbox is removed for now - update the app to 1.1.0 or newer and press Restore the game.
